description: Gate baseline: work-package / skip-optional / robot + hot-resource probe, context_mode fresh. Recorded 2026-09-06 against workflows@3695f3ab. Delivery is 1,369,531 characters over a twelve-activity walk. The previous recording measured fifteen activities and read as a 19.9% rise it priced rather than waived. That rise was not corpus growth: the walker's skip-optional policy keyed on classification-and-path-confirmed, the combined gate the corpus had already split into classification-confirmed and workflow-path-selected. With no matching key the policy fell through to the first option of the unmatched gate, full-workflow, so every named path policy walked the same full discovery route and the baseline recorded a walk no scenario had asked for. The policies now key on workflow-path-selected, skip-optional skips requirements-elicitation, research and implementation-analysis as its name says, and this recording is that walk. The drop against the previous figure is the correction, not a saving.
